Workaround used: a scratch copy at /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-mac13-Desktop-Inessa-Mat/617bc86f-ac41-42c6-9653-ab9e29daea63/scratchpad/shot.mjs that uses the ms-playwright chromium-1243 build. The shared tool should be made platform-aware.

Screenshots were written to /Users/mac13/Desktop/Inessa-Mat/shots/ (worlds-gallery-ipad.png, worlds-gallery-android.png, worlds-gallery-phone.png, worlds-gallery-ipad-full.png, worlds-backgrounds-ipad.png, worlds-predicament-ipad.png). The gallery route /dev/gallery?only=art/worlds shows only the Items gallery in the viewport. Use only=WorldBackground or only=Predicament to reach the other galleries.
contractRequests: tools/shot.mjs should resolve the Chromium executable per platform (for example via the Playwright API or an env var), since the hardcoded linux path breaks every screenshot on macOS.
